shortDescription: Configure or create a syslog configuration for TrendMicro Deep Security

options.name: certificate_chain
options.description: The identity certificate chain the Deep Security Manager will use when it contacts the syslog server over TLS. The identity certificate must be the first certificate in the list, followed by the certificate for the issuing certificate authority (if any) and continuing up the issuer chain. The root certificate authority's certificate does not need to be included. Each element in the list will be an unencrypted PEM-encoded certificate.

options.name: description
options.description: The description for this syslog configuration.

options.name: direct
options.description: The "direct delivery from agent to syslog server" flag

options.name: event_format
options.description: The event format to use when sending syslog messages.

options.name: facility
options.description: The facility value to send with each syslog message.

options.name: id
options.description: The ID of the syslog configuration (when editing an existing configuration).

options.name: name
options.description: The name for this syslog configuration.

options.name: port
options.description: The destination port for syslog messages.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key the Deep Security Manager will use when it contacts the syslog server over TLS. The private key must be an RSA key in PEM-encoded PKCS#1 or PKCS#8 format. To prevent accidental disclosure of the private key, the Deep Security Manager will not return this value; therefore Ansible does not have access to it and it can only be used to set the private key.

options.name: server
options.description: The destination server for syslog messages.

options.name: state
options.description: The state the configuration should be left in The state I(gathered) will make a get call to the module API and transform it into structured data in the format as per the resource module argspec and the value is returned in the I(gathered) key within the result.

options.name: transport
options.description: The transport to use when sending syslog messages.
